about: How fast a dice roll gets through, on the talker fixture's Persuasion check (d20 + modifier against the DC; the game rolls, nothing sets the outcome).
Each round: the talker's dialogue, answer 1 (the check), the roll window, then one way of getting through it, timed from the moment the
window is open to the moment it is gone and the dialogue goes on (the step's ms; the expression is asked every 0.3 s, so +-0.3 s).
watch  : throw, let the dice animation play, continue (GK.Cheat.Step('roll', {watch = true}); what GK.Gui.Resolve{roll='throw'} did before 2026-11-14)
skip   : throw, then the player's click during the animation (UserTriggeredNextPhaseCommand(true), ActiveRoll.xaml's 'Skip on Click'), continue
speed  : as watch, with GK.Speed ${FAST} for the length of the roll only
idle   : nothing at all for 8 s: the window waits for the player's throw
Run: gatekit --instance <copy> mcp sequence tests/_selftest/attention/roll_speed.json --set FAST=10  (GustavX:Basic_Level_A).
